figures.caption: Figure 4: Decode throughput and KV cache size for Keyless vs. QKV attention under GQA. Left: decode throughput (mean ˘ std over 3 seeds) as a function of context length; Keyless exceeds QKV. Right: KV cache size vs Value-Only Cache size; Keyless reduces cache memory by exactly 50% at every context length, since it stores only value states.
